desc: Compute prefix sums `S_n` and `S_c` for indices 0..n-1
Implement `ConvexHullTrick` class using `collections.deque` with `add_line` and `query` methods
Loop `c` from 1 to n, initialize hull with base line `(0, 0)` if `c == 1`, iterate `i` from 0 to n-1
For each `i`: query hull at `x = S_n[i] + k*c`, compute `dp_curr[i]`, add line if `dp_prev[i]` is finite, update global answer
Test edge case `n=1`: answer should be `(nums[0] + k) * cost[0]`
Test edge case all separate subarrays (c=n)
